thread.title: Webhook handler runs twice after a timeout
thread.question: why would one delivery run twice?
thread.answer: A slow first attempt can time out and be retried, because <symbol>processDelivery</symbol> records the delivery ID only after it finishes. Save the ID first in <path>src/webhooks/retry.ts:48</path>.

aiGeneration.title: Anthropic Claude and OpenAI
aiGeneration.description: We use Anthropic’s Claude Messages API and the OpenAI Responses API to generate issue and discussion assistance. Requests may switch between these providers when a provider’s credit or spending limit is reached or its configured availability ends. OpenAI input and output sharing is enabled for the project used by Gitdog. Content sent to OpenAI, including repository excerpts, prompts, and generated responses, may be used to improve and train OpenAI models. Do not connect repositories or submit content you are not authorized to share for this purpose. Repository indexing, semantic code search, and repository learnings also use the OpenAI Embeddings API. These requests include repository code chunks, search queries, and repository learning content, and follow the same OpenAI data-sharing configuration.
items: Relevant repository code excerpts and context
Issue and discussion content, follow-up messages, and tool results
Repository instructions and response preferences provided to Gitdog
